verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs show one agent spanning chat (on-brand chat across web, mobile, and messaging platforms), email, and voice. Integrations and simulations are described as working across those channels. However, the named customer channels (Slack, WhatsApp, social) are never explicitly confirmed, only implied by the generic phrase "messaging platforms", and "mobile" stands in for in-app. Missing for 10: explicit Slack support, explicit WhatsApp support, social-channel coverage, documented in-app SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration.
